posts.title: Terry Godier: "The Boring Internet"
posts.description: The Boring Internet is a wonderful post by Terry Godier about what’s dying and what remains as the internet changes. It echoes my own sentiments about RSS surviving its own death . The core idea is that we shouldn’t care about the platforms, even if they once offered us convenience; we should care about the standards and ways of communicating.
